jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. We are seeking an accomplished Principal Scientist to advance antibody engineering initiatives within the Therapeutic Discovery Sciences Department on the Protein Engineering Team in San Diego, California. This is a laboratory-based position intended for a senior individual contributor who will be responsible for designing, executing, and interpreting experiments that inform early-stage research and contribute to the advancement of platform technologies. The successful candidate will also be responsible for developing new tools and reimagining existing technologies to support the creation of next-generation recombinant antibody therapeutics. In this role, the individual will serve as the antibody engineering lead on discovery project teams, establishing technical direction and strategy for engineering initiatives from conceptualization through lead nomination. The position requires close collaboration with a multidisciplinary team of scientists, with whom platform knowledge, instrumentation, and technical expertise are shared. The individual will also engage regularly with colleagues in antigen design, structural biology, and computational biology. Success in this role is driven by technical expertise, sound scientific judgment, and the integrity and credibility of one's experimental work. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong bench leadership, exercise initiative independently, and perform effectively within a fast-paced, collaborative, and highly matrixed organizational environment. Key Responsibilities Serve as a protein engineering representative on discovery project teams, owning the technical strategy for integrated engineering campaigns from early concept through lead identification, optimization, and nomination. Design, execute, and troubleshoot antibody engineering workflows, including affinity maturation, humanization, format conversion, expression, purification, and characterization. Engineer and evaluate IgG, Fab, scFv, bispecific, multispecific, and emerging antibody formats. Characterize antibodies using SEC, SPR/BLI, and related assays to assess binding and developability. Partner across Biologics Discovery, Structural Biology, Computational Biology, DMPK, Toxicology, and project teams to advance programs. Analyze complex datasets, identify risks, and develop mitigation strategies to guide decisions. Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including AI/ML-enabled antibody design. Lead scientific discussions, present findings, and engage with external partners and CROs. Author protocols, study reports, and technical documentation to a standard suitable for regulatory submission, and maintain rigorous, timely records in electronic laboratory notebooks. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's Degree with 8+ years of academic / industry experience OR Master's Degree with 6+ years of academic / industry experience OR PhD with 4+ years of academic / industry experience. PhD in protein science, structural biology, biochemistry, or related scientific discipline. Hands-on expertise in antibody engineering, including design, expression, purification, and characterization of bispecific and multispecific formats. Direct experience with SPR/BLI, ELISA, flow cytometry, and other protein interaction and functional assays. Proven ability to design, plan, and execute experiments and troubleshoot complex problems independently, with the expectation of spending the majority of your time at the bench. Experience providing scientific leadership and influencing project decisions through technical expertise. Demonstrated impact through publications, patents, or advancement of therapeutic discovery programs. Strong collaborator with experience working across multiple programs, functions, and sites in a matrix environment. Excellent organizational, documentation, presentation, written, and verbal communication skills. Preferred Experience with advanced antibody-based formats such as antibody-drug conjugates or multispecific-related approaches. 2+ years of biotech or pharmaceutical experience. Familiarity with antibody sequence analysis, bioinformatics, physics-based protein modeling, AI/ML-enabled discovery tools, or developability prediction platforms. Experience with biophysical and structural techniques such as X-ray crystallography, cryo-EM, isothermal titration calorimetry, or multi-angle light scattering. Experience applying antibody discovery or engineering approaches in oncology, immunology, neuroscience, or other therapeutic relevant areas. Experience in neuroscience or prior experience as project lead in pharma or biotech setting Experience training or providing technical guidance to fellow scientists and research associates in a team-based laboratory setting. #LI-Onsite We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. jobs.description: Amazon’s Quick Commerce organization is exploring a new operating model to expand our network and deliver everyday essentials to customers faster. We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to develop and lead our third-party integration strategy, creating a scalable model that enables external partners to secure, launch, and operate Quick Commerce sites. The Senior Program Manager will work across Global Procurement Operations (GPO), Finance, Legal, Operations, Real Estate, Product, and other partner teams to evaluate external benchmarks, assess model trade-offs, and define the path from initial pilot through broader network expansion. The ideal candidate can move between strategy and execution. They will build detailed business cases, evaluate complex financial and operational trade-offs, and translate ambiguity into a clear, scalable plan. They must also be comfortable influencing senior leaders, challenging existing assumptions, and establishing new processes across multiple organizations. Key job responsibilities - Develop the end-to-end business plan and leadership proposal for Quick Commerce’s 3P operating model. - Define a scalable approach for third-party partners to source, secure, launch, and operate Quick Commerce sites. - Evaluate potential 3P models, including under-the-roof operations, site acquisition, launch support, ongoing operations, and fully outsourced solutions. - Partner with GPO to identify, evaluate, and qualify potential third-party operators and supporting suppliers. - Work with Finance to develop detailed financial models, cost benchmarks, investment requirements, and comparisons against first-party operations. - Partner with Legal to define contractual frameworks, compliance requirements, liability structures, performance expectations, and appropriate controls. - Work with Real Estate and Operations to establish site requirements, approval processes, launch standards, and operating mechanisms. - Use internal and external benchmarks to assess partner economics, operating structures, launch timelines, and scaling potential. - Develop clear assessments of financial, operational, customer experience, compliance, and execution risks, along with proposed mitigations. - Define pilot requirements, success criteria, performance metrics, governance mechanisms, and the roadmap for scaling beyond the initial launch. - Establish clear ownership and integration points across Amazon and third-party partners throughout site development, launch, and steady-state operations. - Create mechanisms to monitor partner performance, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvement. - Prepare and present business proposals, recommendations, and decision documents to senior leadership. - Drive alignment and execution across teams with different priorities, constraints, and areas of ownership. COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR's Technology team is responsible for building and supporting the firm's technological foundation including a globally distributed infrastructure, information security, and the application and data platforms. POSITION SUMMARY

KKR is seeking a Data Engineer to lead the design and construction of world-class data engineering capabilities for the Human Capital domain. This is a pivotal, hands-on technical leadership role requiring deep expertise in modern data engineering and a proven ability to derive critical insights from complex, sensitive people data. Partnering closely with Human Capital leadership and the Human Capital Engineering team, the successful candidate will define the technical blueprint for how KKR structures, stores, and leverages people data to power its analytics and AI platforms across the employee lifecycle — spanning talent acquisition, core HC, performance, compensation, learning, and HC operations. The role ensures data integrity, performance, accessibility, and — critically — the confidentiality and governance demanded by sensitive workforce, compensation, and performance data.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead the Human Capital Data Engineering function and set the strategic direction for the design, modernization, and scaling of people data platforms, pipelines, and reporting capabilities across the employee lifecycle — from talent acquisition and onboarding through performance, compensation, learning and development, and HC operations.
• Own and drive the multi-year data engineering roadmap for Human Capital, establishing a consolidated people data platform and semantic models that enable consistent, trusted reporting and analytics across HC functions.
• Establish the target-state architecture for people data, including scalable data models, ingestion frameworks, data pipelines, and analytics-ready platforms that support workforce, talent, performance, compensation, and people-operations reporting needs.
• Partner with the Chief Human Capital Officer, HC Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Talent Management, Learning & Development, People Analytics, and HC Operations — as well as Human Capital Engineering — to align data engineering initiatives with the firm's people strategy and business priorities.

• Lead the modernization of legacy HC data environments and reporting processes by introducing scalable, cloud-aligned, and highly governed engineering patterns that improve quality, transparency, timeliness, and reusability of people data.
• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of data engineers and technical leads, fostering strong execution, talent development, engineering discipline, and a culture of accountability and innovation.
• Establish and enforce best practices for data architecture, security, access models, and platform governance — with particular attention to the confidentiality of compensation, performance, and employee relations data and to global data privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
• 12+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related technology roles, including significant experience leading teams and delivering large-scale enterprise data platforms.
• Deep experience designing and scaling data models, ETL/ELT pipelines, and analytics platforms that support complex business processes and cross-functional consumption; familiarity with the Human Capital / HC data domain and employee-lifecycle processes strongly preferred.
• Proven track record of leading enterprise data modernization programs, including data warehouse transformation, pipeline re-architecture, cloud migration, and operating model improvement.
• Expertise in modern data engineering and platform technologies, including SQL, Python, cloud-based data ecosystems, orchestration tools, and warehouse or lakehouse architectures.
• Hands-on familiarity with integrating best-of-breed HC / enterprise platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or Oracle HCM; ATS, LMS, and HR service delivery systems) into governed enterprise data environments via APIs, event streams, and iPaaS integration patterns.
• Strong understanding of data governance, controls, lineage, security, and auditability requirements, including global employment and data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and their implications for people-data architecture.
• Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value and to influence senior stakeholders across Human Capital and Technology.

CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS

• Strategic mindset — able to design and communicate a long-term vision for the Human Capital data platform while delivering incremental business value each cycle.
• Stakeholder management — strong ability to engage, influence, and align diverse stakeholders across Human Capital, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Technology functions globally.
• Execution discipline — skilled at prioritization, governance, and managing delivery across a multi-workstream portfolio without compromising quality.
• Data stewardship — deep commitment to confidentiality, controls, and responsible handling of sensitive people, compensation, and performance data.
• Team leadership — proven ability to build, develop, and retain high-performing engineering teams, set clear goals, and foster a culture of ownership and continuous learning.
• Analytical and problem-solving — strong skills in translating complex data challenges into scalable, governed engineering solutions.
• Change leadership — able to drive adoption of modern data practices and embed them into HC and technology workflows.
• Operating in ambiguity — demonstrated ability to lead large, high-visibility transformation efforts and deliver results across multiple concurrent priorities.

About the Team

The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments as well as other OpenAI products worldwide. We operate across the full funnel - from awareness and acquisition through activation, retention, and expansion - using a combination of global performance marketing, AI-powered workflows, in-product optimization, insights, experimentation, and creative ops engineering.

About the Role

We are hiring a Lifecycle Lead to build the company-wide owned-channel capability that helps teams reach businesses with relevant, timely, and trustworthy experiences. This senior, hands-on leader will set the small and medium business lifecycle strategy, partner with Engineering to build the orchestration and deployment platform, and establish the operating model that allows teams across the company to launch and improve evergreen programs safely at scale.

You will sit at the intersection of platform, product, and campaign strategy. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Analytics on the underlying systems, and with Product Marketing Managers and other client teams to design journeys that help new, active, and returning businesses reach value and build durable habits.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Partner with B2B product to set the company-wide vision, roadmap, and operating model for lifecycle and owned-channel engagement.

- Partner with Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Analytics to shape the tooling and infrastructure for identity, audiences, eligibility, consent, triggers, orchestration, decisioning, frequency, experimentation, localization, quality assurance, and observability.

- Define scalable deployment workflows—including self-service and centrally supported paths, intake, templates, approvals, governance, service levels, and incident response—so teams across the company can launch safely and efficiently.

- Partner with Product Marketing Managers and other client teams to translate audience, product, and business goals into evergreen journey strategies across onboarding, activation, continuation, retention, resurrection, and monetization.

- Lead the design, launch, iteration, and optimization of templates and journeys across email, push, and in-product messaging, including the deep-linked landing and post-click product experiences that complete the loop.

- Partner with Growth DS to build a measurement system that connects reach, eligibility, delivery, engagement, landing behavior, task completion, retained activity, and incremental value through sound experiments and holdouts.

- Optimize the small and medium business lifecycle portfolio—not just individual sends—by improving inventory, relevance, personalization, prioritization, and per-user frequency.

- Inform our owned channel / upsell strategy–establish a high bar for deliverability, user preferences, localization, and operational quality, and trust while influencing senior stakeholders across the company.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- 10+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, retention, growth, product marketing, or marketing technology, ideally in a global B2B business serving self serve small businesses, enterprises, and developers.

- A track record of building and scaling lifecycle tooling or platforms with Engineering for multiple teams, products, audiences, or markets.

- Strong technical and product fluency across event and identity models, data pipelines, APIs, segmentation, triggering, decisioning, experimentation, and deployment systems; coding experience is not required.

- Deep campaign and journey craft, with experience designing evergreen programs that move users from message to product value and durable behavior.

- Strong experimentation and measurement judgment, including incrementality, holdouts, cohort quality, retention, and lifetime value—not just delivery or click metrics.

- Experience creating operating models, governance, templates, and quality standards that increase organizational velocity without creating channel chaos.

- Executive-level cross-functional influence and clear communication across Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics, PMM, Creative, Legal, Privacy, and regional teams.
